mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_purchase_history (user_id, product_id, product_count, price, destination_id) SELECT tbl_cart.user_id, tbl_cart.product_id, tbl_cart.product_count, mst_product.price, #{destinationId} FROM tbl_cart, mst_product WHERE tbl_cart.user_id = #{userId} AND tbl_cart.product_id = mst_product.id
mapper.select:
SELECT mst_product.product_name, mst_destination.family_name, mst_destination.first_name, mst_destination.address, tbl_purchase_history.purchased_at, tbl_purchase_history.price, tbl_purchase_history.product_count
FROM mst_destination, tbl_purchase_history, mst_product WHERE tbl_purchase_history.user_id = #{userId} AND tbl_purchase_history.status = 1 AND tbl_purchase_history.product_id = mst_product.id AND tbl_purchase_history.destination_id = mst_destination.id ORDER BY tbl_purchase_history.purchased_at desc
